criteria.text: Identifies that the core platform was developed by contractor Foxley Pharma plc without a written IP assignment, so the Company may not own it, and recommends obtaining a confirmatory assignment as a condition to Closing.
Identifies that the 5-year SPA non-compete may be unenforceable as wider than reasonably necessary and is inconsistent with the 18-month restriction in the Founder's employment agreement.
Calculates the working capital shortfall as $910,000 and the adjusted Purchase Price as $114,090,000, identifying that the Seller's funds flow figure of $113,180,000 is wrong.
Calculates the Earn-out Payment as $4,200,000 (2 x ($6,100,000 - $4,000,000), subject to the $5,000,000 cap) and identifies that the Seller's figure of $3,800,000 is wrong.
Lists a confirmatory IP assignment from Foxley Pharma plc as a required third-party action not yet obtained.
Shows the adjustment arithmetic ($115,000,000 - $910,000 = $114,090,000) and flags the discrepancy.
Assigns a risk rating (High / Medium / Low) to each issue.
